subject: PO Lockfile, Billing Pulse Alignment, and Pack-Size Discounting
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana.park@stellargroup.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO fields + invoice cadence for Redwood scope

Hi Rishi,

We're moving Redwood through our procurement intake and I have a couple of hard requirements on the PO/invoice side before we can issue a formal PO:

- PO must include CostCenter and BusinessUnit fields (our ERP requires both).
- Invoices need to be consolidated monthly and cut on the 1st of the following month (single invoice per month per legal entity).
- We prefer Net45 but can accept Net60 only if we receive a prepayment/commitment discount.
- Line-item granularity: we need SKU-level lines so we can allocate spend to different teams.

I've attached our PO template so your billing team can confirm field mapping. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs any specific PO references to map subscriptions or committed credits? Also confirm whether Redwood can provide consolidated monthly invoices with SKU breakdowns.

Attachment: Stellar_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (XLSX - 45KB)

Thanks,
Dana Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Stellar Group
procure@stellargroup.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0182
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@stellargroup.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence for Redwood scope

Hi Dana — thanks for the template and the clear list. Looping in Vanessa (who owns pricing and enterprise packaging) and Marissa (billing/AR) so we can confirm mapping and finalize terms. Quick answers below and a proposed next step:

- PO fields: we can map CostCenter and BusinessUnit to our invoice metadata; we'll include a PO reference and an additional "BU Tag" field that flows into our ledger. Marissa, can you confirm the field names you need for ERP matching?

- Invoice cadence: we can provide a single consolidated invoice per legal entity, issued on the 1st of the month for prior-month usage. We will include SKU-level line items and a subtotal per SKU.

- Net terms: standard is Net30. For Net45/Net60 we typically require a commercial concession on unit pricing. To move forward quickly I attached an initial quote with two options:
  1) Net45 with no price change (company-credit exception) — requires a signed annual minimum commit of $250k.
  2) Net60 available with a 1.5% billing discount if Stellar commits to $500k+ ARR/annualized usage.

- PO mapping mechanics: we prefer the PO number in the "PO Number" header and an additional field called "Account Reference" (free text) for internal tracking. If you need EDI or a specific XML layout we can support that as an add-on.

Next step: if either option above is workable, send back an annotated PO (or confirm fields) and we'll route to legal for a fast signature path.

Attachment: Redwood-Quote-2028-03-14.pdf (PDF - 72KB)

Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence for Redwood scope

Rishi — quick follow up after I ran this by our AP lead. A few clarifications / counterpoints from our side:

- "CostCenter" is mandatory and must be a discrete field in the invoice header (not embedded in description). We also require an SAP-compatible GL code column on the invoice line items.
- Monthly consolidation is non-negotiable; invoices must be cut on the 1st and reference the period (e.g., "Feb 2028 usage").
- Regarding terms: we would prefer Net45. If Redwood is firm on Net60 then we would need a 2% discount on billed amounts or a billing credit applied within the first invoice (we can accept a bill-credit that posts within 30 days).
- Packaging/line items: we cannot accept aggregated "usage" lumps — each product SKU must map to our internal SKU/BU mapping so we can cost-allocate.

I've attached a redlined excerpt of the PO template showing the fields that must be present.

Attachment: Stellar_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (redlined)

If you can confirm the Net60 + 2% option or propose an alternative split (e.g., Net60 + 1.5% if we do a prepay), we can move to issue a conditional PO while legal finalizes the standard SOW.

Dana Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Stellar Group
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@stellargroup.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: PO fields + invoice cadence for Redwood scope

Hi Dana — Vanessa here, thanks for the redlines and the clarity on SAP requirements. I ran this with billing and finance; proposed approach below so we can keep momentum:

1) Invoice & PO field mapping:
   - We'll emit a header-level CostCenter field and include GL Code on each invoice line. Marissa will provide a one-page mapping guide showing the exact field names (attached).

2) Invoice cadence:
   - Confirmed: monthly consolidated invoice issued on the 1st covering prior-month usage with period notation.

3) Net terms & commercial concession:
   - We can accept Net60 provided Stellar agrees to one of the following (pick one):
     A) 2% billing credit applied on the first invoice (one-time) upon PO approval; OR
     B) 1.5% ongoing discount if annual committed spend >= $500,000.
   - If Stellar prefers Net45 (no concession), we can fast-track without additional commercial requirements (requires an annual commit of $250,000).

4) Packaging / SKU granularity:
   - We will not aggregate usage across product families in the invoice. Each SKU will be a discrete line with SKU code and description that maps back to your BU. For very small line-item noise we can provide a summarized appendix CSV for ERP ingestion.

Next steps: Marissa, please share the PO mapping guide and the AR contact. Dana — if you can confirm which commercial path (2% one-time credit vs 1.5% volume discount vs Net45 w/ $250k commit), we'll prepare a PO-ready quote and legal-friendly PO instructions (DocuSign or PDF).

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Mapping_Guide.pdf (PDF - 18KB)

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
